# Cathode Farm

> A 1994-style AppleTalk render farm built from emulated Macintoshes in Docker.
> Each container runs one emulated Mac (System 7.5) on a patched Basilisk II with
> an ADB-layer control server, so the classic Macs are scriptable like any service.
> The nodes share one virtual EtherTalk segment (Basilisk udptunnel) to network
> over AppleTalk the way a room of Quadras did in 1994.

Cathode Farm turns the question "how was Toy Story rendered?" into a working cluster
of vintage Macs you can spin up with one command. Pixar's genuine MacRenderMan launches inside the emulated Mac but never renders a frame
(it stops at Pixar's 1994 serial gate, which we did not have and did not crack). Every
rendered image is produced by BMRT, a free open-source RenderMan-compliant renderer, on
the same RIB spec 30 years later. MacRenderMan runs; BMRT renders.

## Core

- [README](README.md): what it is, the control protocol, how to run the farm.
- [Basilisk II ADB control-server patch](patches/basilisk-adb-control-server.patch): the
  one code change. A TCP server that injects mouse/keyboard at the ADB layer with precise
  timing, replacing unreliable host-side X11 injection.
- [Dockerfile](docker/Dockerfile): multi-stage image that compiles the patched emulator
  inside the container so it matches the runtime glibc.
- [docker-compose.yml](docker/docker-compose.yml): a farm of named EtherTalk nodes.

## Control

- [macctl.sh](macctl.sh): drive a node from the host (click, double-click, type, key, screenshot).
- [mcp/server.py](mcp/server.py): the farm as MCP tools (screenshot + reliable input) for assistants.

## Renders

- [renders/](renders/): original Toy Story-flavored RenderMan scenes rendered with BMRT
  (toy_hero 960x720 ~38s, toy_balls/blocks/figure 640x480 ~8s each). Generators included.

## Notes

- Requires you to supply a Macintosh ROM, a System 7.5 disk image, and StuffIt Expander;
  these are not shipped for licensing reasons. See the README.
- License: GPL-2.0 (Basilisk II is GPL by Christian Bauer and contributors).
